name: ABot-World 0.5 Iris (5B real-time interactive world model)
summary: Open-weight 5B causal world model that turns a still image into a real-time interactive video world you steer with the keyboard (WASD/IJKL) and change with text prompts mid-rollout. Streams ~21 FPS on a single RTX 5090 per the publisher; fine-tuned from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, with a streaming FantasyDecoder. Ships with a Gradio demo and six interactive example scenes.

access.notes: Ungated. Third-party parts listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (Wan2.2 Apache-2.0, etc.). Demo sample images: replace before redistribution. Larger Halo 30B model is not part of this release. Needs a high-end NVIDIA GPU.

procedure: Clone the code: https://github.com/amap-cvlab/ABot-World and follow its setup
Download weights: hf download acvlab/ABot-World-0-5-5B-Iris --local-dir checkpoints/ABot-World-0-5-5B-Iris (or ModelScope amap_cvlab/ABot-World-0-5-5B-Iris)
Run the demo: bash web_client/run.sh, pick a scene, steer with WASD/IJKL

verdict.why: Fresh, ungated Apache-2.0 weights for a playable image-to-world model, same family of resource as Hy-Nomas already in the catalog. Useful for prototyping interactive scenes; FPS figures are the publisher's own, and it needs a top-end GPU.
